pick.headline: Yeltsin's Decree 1400 dissolves the Russian parliament
pick.fbis: The supplement on Russia's presidential-parliamentary crisis of September 23, 1993, carried Rutskoy's declaration that he had become acting president and was repealing "anticonstitutional and illegal Edict No. 1400," and his edict overruling Yeltsin from ROSSIYSKAYA GAZETA.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Central Eurasia Supplement - Presidential-Parliamentary Crisis in Russia, 23 September 1993
evidence.snippet: …preme Soviet Presidium, declare that as of 0025 hours 22 September 1993, | become acting Russian Federation president. | have signed the appropriate edicts. alternates.headline: Armenians vote for independence in a referendum
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 23, 1991, carried a TASS review of PRAVDA, whose Yerevan correspondent reported that 95 percent of voters in the September 21 referendum backed Armenia becoming an independent democratic state outside the Soviet Union, while Ter-Petrosyan promised to join an economic treaty.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 184, 23 September 1991
evidence.snippet: …ars merits approval. It is regrettable that such a serious step has become possible only after the virtual break-up of the Soviet Union”, the newspaper writes in a signed article.
